summary: The recorded base reproduces the flat non-streaming OpenAI error body. The exact candidate wraps it in the required error envelope, preserves status and inner fields, has a regression that fails on base and passes on candidate, and passes independent serializer and official SDK transport boundary cases.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's three regression tests were run unchanged against the recorded base; all three failed because the non-streaming body lacked the error envelope.
Exact candidate source and affected serving callers: 160 passed, 68 subtests passed.
Independent envelope/status/header/field checks for empty, Unicode, 400, 401 and 422 errors, plus official OpenAI SDK parsing through an HTTP transport mock.

gpu_execution.evidence: The available device reports AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950, but the candidate changes only Python JSON response serialization and no GPU path is involved.

remaining_limitations: No live model server or model weights were used; model semantics and full serving startup were not evaluated.
No distributed or multi-node workload was exercised.
GPU execution and native rebuild are not applicable to this Python-only serializer change.
